meta.title: Conversion summary shows vendors who quoted; View All RFQs returns to the RFQ

steps.note: Start a multi-stage event creation flow for the RFQ.
Configure the event as an RFQ, which is required before conversion.
Add a product that vendors can quote.
Commit a valid bidding schedule before publication.
Invite two vendors so the conversion summary can be checked against two quoting vendors.
Publish the RFQ so vendors can submit quotes.
Confirm the RFQ reached its published project page.
Submit a quote from the first vendor.
Confirm the first vendor's quote was accepted.
Submit a quote from a different vendor.
Confirm the second vendor's quote was accepted.
Establish that exactly two vendors have submitted direct RFQ responses before conversion.
Open the Auction Setup screen reached through RFQ-to-Auction conversion.
Confirm the conversion screen exposes the control that should return to the RFQ.

args.goal: On the Auction Setup screen, verify that the conversion summary reports 2 vendors who submitted quotes, click View All RFQs, and stop on the RFQ bids view showing the existing vendor quotes

steps.note: Exercise the conversion summary and return control together because no specialized catalog assertion reads this summary or performs this exact navigation.
Confirm that returning through View All RFQs landed on the RFQ response view with both existing bids visible.
